Waffle chart: a unit grid of counts

Source: R/waffle.R
calor_waffle.Rd

Counts become cells on the same square grid as a heatmap: one cell per share of the total, filled column by column from the bottom. Give a by column to draw one waffle per group side by side.

Usage

calor_waffle(
  data,
  category = NULL,
  count = NULL,
  by = NULL,
  n = 100,
  rows = 10,
  cell_size = 4,
  cell_gap = 0.15,
  cell_radius = 0.3,
  interactive = FALSE
)

Arguments

data

A named vector of counts, or a data frame.

category, count, by

Column names when data is a data frame.

n

Cells per waffle.

rows

Rows per waffle.

cell_size, cell_gap, cell_radius

Cell geometry, as in ggcalor().

interactive

Add 'ggiraph' tooltips; hovering a cell highlights its category in every waffle. Render with calor_girafe().

Value

A ggplot object.

Examples

calor_waffle(c(apples = 45, pears = 30, plums = 25), n = 100, rows = 10)

df <- data.frame(region = rep(c("north", "south"), each = 3),
                 crop = rep(c("wheat", "rice", "maize"), 2), tons = c(5, 3, 2, 1, 6, 3))
calor_waffle(df, "crop", "tons", by = "region", n = 50, rows = 10)
